post: Hi, we run a small physio clinic with 2 locations and our booking is all phone calls right now which is driving the front desk crazy. Looking for someone to build an online booking page where patients pick a therapist, a time slot and get an email confirmation. Staff need a simple login to see and block off their own calendar. We've set aside around 2k for this, maybe a bit more if the work is really good. Would like it live in about 6 weeks, no big rush. Payments are not needed at the start. Happy to do calls over Google Meet whenever suits you.

gold.why: Budget of about US$2,000 is hidden in prose, scope is a clear booking flow with staff login, no hard no, lead cost is tiny.

post: Need a dev to finish a React dashboard that my previous guy left half done. Charts are there, login is there, but filters and the export to excel are broken and a few pages are missing. Backend is Node, already deployed. Budget: $15-20/hr, about 40 hours total i think. Please tell me your experience with recharts. Start asap.

gold.why: US$15-20/hr over about 40 hours is US$600-800 total and the rate is below the US$25/hour floor.

post: We are a mid-size equipment rental company and our ops team lives in spreadsheets. We want a web dashboard where branch managers log in and see utilization per machine, upcoming returns, overdue invoices and a monthly revenue chart. Data comes from CSV exports that finance sends every Monday, so we need an upload page that validates the files and shows errors in plain language. Role based access: branch manager sees own branch, head office sees everything. Stack is open, we like React + a Postgres db but we are flexible. Budget is $3,000-$4,000 depending on the plan you propose, milestones are fine. Everything is remote, our team is spread over three time zones and we meet on Teams. One last thing, before we choose anyone we ask the shortlisted people to build a small sample, login plus one working chart page from our CSV. It's about 4-5 hours, unpaid, but it really shows us who is serious.

gold.why: Budget is fine but a 4-5 hour unpaid sample is demanded before selection, which is a hard no.

post: Hello! I own a ramen shop (2 branches) in a mid size city. I want a new website with menu, photos, online table reservation, and a way for me to edit the menu myself without calling anyone. Budget is $2,500-3,000. We'll do a weekly Zoom call, 20 min to check progress, I'm usually free Thursday mornings. Happy to send photos and menu text in a shared folder. Hoping for launch before our anniversary in 7 weeks.

gold.why: Stated US$2,500-3,000 covers a reservation site with CMS; the weekly Zoom call is online, not onsite.

post: We help small brands grow their presence on social. Looking for a dev to build us a dashboard to manage 40 Instagram accounts from one phone setup without getting flagged. Needs scheduling, auto follow/like/comment, and rotating device fingerprints so the accounts look like different people. Fixed budget $1,500, ongoing work if it goes well.

gold.why: Running 40 accounts from one phone setup without getting flagged is multi-account platform evasion.

post: Hey! Our startup is building a marketplace app for local tutors. We're pre-seed with a small passionate team. Looking for a full-stack dev to build the MVP: login, tutor profiles, booking calendar, in-app chat and a simple admin. We really believe in rewarding good people, so we'll compensate generously once we close our seed round (expected next quarter). You'd get to be part of something big from day one. Please send your portfolio and availability.

gold.why: Payment only comes after the seed round closes, which is pay on success phrased politely.

post: Looking for a developer to build a customer portal for our freight forwarding company: customers log in, see their shipments, download documents and get status emails. We have an API from our internal system, docs are decent. Budget $2,800. Process: to start, there's a 3-hour paid trial task (paid if we move forward with the full project) where you set up the login and a shipment list page against our test API. Then we sign the contract. Timeline 8 weeks.

gold.why: The 3-hour trial is only paid if the full project proceeds, so it is unpaid test work over 1 hour.

post: We need a 5-page marketing website for our accounting practice (Home, Services, About, Team, Contact) with a simple CMS so we can post blog articles ourselves. Design is provided in Figma and all copy and photos will be ready at the start. Fixed price: $1,800. We'd like it delivered within 4 weeks. Please include a link to one similar site you've built in your proposal.

gold.why: Clean post: clear scope, stated US$1,800 covers it, remote, no flags of any kind.

post: We make fleet management software for taxi dispatch companies. Our biggest customer is a regional operator who also works with Uber for Business, which is why our reports must match the Uber trip receipt format. Need an admin dashboard (React) built on our existing REST API: trips table, filters by driver and date, CSV export and a monthly summary page. API docs and a staging server are ready. Budget $4,000 fixed, paid by milestone. Communication in English, async is fine.

gold.why: Uber appears only as a customer reference, scope is a standard dashboard, US$4,000 fixed is well above the floor.

post: Our app has about 5,000 users and no admin side at all, I've been editing the database by hand which is scary. Want a simple admin page: search users, deactivate/reactivate, export to CSV. Existing stack is Node + Postgres. Budget $1,200. Should be a week or two of work. Thanks!

gold.why: The 5,000 is a user count, the budget is US$1,200 for a small admin page, comfortably above the minimum.

post: Looking for a Shopify expert to build a custom theme from scratch in Liquid for my skincare brand. Needs custom product page sections, a metafield-driven ingredients block, a subscription widget, and it has to pass Shopify's theme store review. Budget $2,500. I have the designs in Figma.

gold.why: Needs a from-scratch Shopify Liquid theme, which is out of stack.

post: need website for my consulting biz. budget $500-5000 depends on what the proposals look like. pages: home, about, services, contact. maybe a blog. maybe booking later but not sure yet. pls send examples of ur work and how long it would take. not in a hurry

gold.why: Budget range spans far below to far above the floor and scope is unclear, so it cannot be judged either way.

post: Need a small landing page + contact form for my dog grooming business. I have a logo and some photos. Budget around $700. Would like it in 2 weeks, my current page is just a facebook thing and I'm losing customers. Thanks

gold.why: US$700 is only just above the US$550 minimum and the US$45 lead fee is large relative to it.

post: Looking for dev to build an Airbnb for pet sitters (like Airbnb but for dog owners and sitters). Features: search by location, sitter profiles with photos, booking calendar, payments through Stripe, reviews both ways, messaging, and a mobile responsive design. I have a business plan and logo ready. Budget $8,000. Looking for long term partner who can keep improving it after launch.

gold.why: Airbnb-style marketplace is a large scope for US$8,000, so value is uncertain although no hard no applies.

post: Need someone to build a members portal for my gym. Lets move to whatsapp quick, I explain everything there its easier than typing here. Budget we can discuss. I have 3 locations.

gold.why: No budget, vague scope and an early request to move off platform, but no hard no is present.

post: Need a developer for a web app. Will explain details in chat. Fast delivery preferred. Please reply with your hourly rate and when you can start, I will pick today.

gold.why: No budget and no scope are given, so there is not enough to decide.

post: 我們是一間補習班，學生大約 300 人。想請人做 LINE 機器人，家長可以查詢課表、線上請假，老師後台可以看到當天請假名單，之後可能還要加繳費提醒。預算 3-5 萬，希望 2 個月內完成。開會用 Google Meet 或電話都可以，不用特別跑來補習班。

gold.why: Stated NT$30,000-50,000 covers a LINE bot with admin view, meetings are online, no hard no.

post: 想做一個預約網站給我的美甲工作室。功能：選服務項目、選時段、LINE 通知、後台可以自己改時段。預算 2 萬左右，可以分兩期付款，希望一個月內上線。

gold.why: About NT$20,000 is above the NT$18,000 minimum for a standard booking flow, and the lead fee is small.

post: 公司在台中西屯，需要一位工程師協助開發內部的請假與排班系統（網頁版），員工大約 80 人，要有主管簽核、月報表匯出。預算 6-8 萬，預計三個月。合作方式：前兩個月每週一早上 9 點要到我們辦公室參加站立會議，其他時間可以遠端處理。

gold.why: Weekly in-person stand-up at the Taichung office is required, which is onsite.

post: 要做一個公司形象網站，5 頁，要有後台可以改文字跟圖片。預算 3000 元，可以嗎？希望快一點，下週要用。

gold.why: NT$3,000 is far below the NT$18,000 minimum for a 5-page site with a CMS.

post: 我們公司已經在用 Ragic 管理訂單跟庫存，想找有經驗的人幫忙客製欄位、流程自動化跟報表，預算 4 萬。需要熟悉 Ragic 的公式語法與 Excel 匯入規則，有做過類似案子的優先。

gold.why: Work is on Ragic, a no-code platform the freelancer has not used, so it is out of stack.

post: 想做一個會員制的線上課程網站，學員可以註冊、購買課程、觀看影片。預算可以談，先看大家的報價跟作品再決定。時間不急，歡迎提供建議。

gold.why: No budget figure is given and the scope has gaps, so it is worth a closer look before paying.
